decisions.reason: The arched one-tier pyramid sits squarely within the firm's Erzgebirge pyramid craftsmanship, so the firm can read its results and refine it, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 points to some risk of model rotation.

With the electronic music box line and its generic platform already withdrawn, this motif platform has lost its supporting system, and it relies on electronics knowledge the firm lacks, so its resources are better returned to the core craft business.

The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established pyramid techniques and regional design knowledge, letting it assimilate feedback and keep the piece as part of its premium seasonal range.
